_comment: Copy to api_keys.json and fill in. api_keys.json is gitignored - never commit real keys. Any provider is optional except gemini: the Live voice session only exists there. A value may be a single string or a list; a list is a pool that rotates automatically when one key hits a free-tier rate limit.
_gemini: Text, vision and tool calls. Get keys at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
_gemini_voice: Reserved for the Live voice session. Keep this a DIFFERENT key from the text pool - voice is the only subsystem with no fallback, so it must not share a quota with text work.
_aliases: Remaps the model names hardcoded in the action modules. Google's floating -latest aliases can sit at 503 for hours while a pinned sibling answers instantly; this is the one place to redirect them. Leave empty to use the call sites verbatim.
_sarvam: Indian-language models, prepaid. Ordered last so credits are not spent on work a free route can do. https://dashboard.sarvam.ai
_order: Text tier failover order. Remove a provider to take it out of the chain.
_local: Optional local LLM (Ollama / LM Studio). Not required.
_listener: How easily you can talk over the assistant: 'headphones' (easiest - no speaker echo), 'balanced' (default, laptop speakers), 'noisy' (loud speakers or a busy room).
_file_roots: Extra directories file operations may touch, beyond your home folder. System folders and the AURA install are always denied.
_barge_in: Let yourself talk over the assistant. Off by default: it depends on a correct speaker-echo estimate, and a wrong one makes the assistant interrupt itself. Safe with headphones.
_spotify: Optional and free: create an app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Without these, 'play <song>' can only open Spotify search results; with them it plays the exact track. Uses the client-credentials flow - search only, no account access.
